messages:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: PROD decode node 'decode-12' reported GPU OOMs during streaming decode. 95% request errors (OOM), recent spike at 2024-11-20T14:07:48Z. Pager: oncall@redwood.

sam (oncall): I'm on it. Can someone confirm customer impact? Which routes affected?

maria (eng-sre): Seeing a ton of `cudaRuntimeError: out of memory` in decode-12 logs. Root cause looks like sudden runaway token generation from a small subset of requests. Kernel frames here: `decode_loop->attn->kv_cache` repeated until OOM.

jordan (infra): decode-12 host metrics: GPU mem jumped to 100% for the PID serving stream sessions. Node restarted once at 14:09:03. Container crash loop started 14:09, back up 14:10 but thrashing.

sam (oncall): Can we triage quick mitigation: 1) isolate node, 2) route traffic away, 3) apply token guard?

maria (eng-sre): Doing now. Routing policy applied to remove decode-12 from pool. Triggering model-fallback to smaller-quantized variant for the affected route.

lee (support): Customer ops reported ~120 failed requests in US-west over the last 3m, 2 customers filing ticket. Marking high priority for CS.

jordan (infra): I pushed a temporary throttle policy at the router: `max_concurrent_per_customer=8` and `enforce_max_tokens=true` for the model route. Also disabled server-side streaming for that route as stopgap.

maria (eng-sre): Note from logs: a small percentage of requests had `max_tokens` header missing and defaulted to server-side unlimited in our older compat path. Suspect misconfigured client lib caused runaway generation. Searching for matching request IDs now.

sam (oncall): If that's the case, we should patch the compat path. Is there a quick hotpatch?

maria (eng-sre): Pushing a runtime hotfix to enforce a hard upper-bound of 2048 tokens on the compat path and to reject headerless requests with a warning. Command I ran: ``kubectl exec -it svc-router -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/route-update -d '{"enforce_max_tokens":true}'`` — rolled out to US-west.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-20241120-42. Pagerduty incident pinned.

sam (oncall): Good. Jordan, keep node isolated for now. Maria, follow up with root-cause trace and attach any offending request ids to INC-20241120-42. Lee, please notify the two customers with a brief: we experienced brief request failures due to runaway generations, mitigation applied, no data loss, ETA for postmortem tomorrow EOD.

lee (support): Will draft now.

maria (eng-sre): Found two suspicious client request IDs (r: 2a7f, r: 2a81) that sent empty `max_tokens`. I'm saving traces and KV cache dumps to the incident folder and will include logs.

sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. Current status: traffic routed away, throttle + fallback in place, node quarantined. Monitoring for recurrence. Will hand off to eng-sre for full RCA.

maria (eng-sre): A note for postmortem: consider runtime hard caps on per-request tokens, improve compat path validation, and add a telemetry alert for token-rate-per-session.

ops-bot: Timeline updated on INC-20241120-42. Next update in 30m or on call back.
